get.description: Liveness + database check, for the uptime monitor.

schema.title: Response List Datasets Api Datasets Get

delete.description: Deletes the dataset, its files and all of its runs.

get.description: Schema, sample and statistics of the uploaded data. Poll while status is 'pending'.

What a custom network can be built from: entities, link fields and models.

Availability comes from the dataset's profile (column fill). While the
profile isn't ready, everything is offered.

post.description: Queue a network build. Poll GET /runs/{id} until status is succeeded/failed.

schema.title: Response List Runs Api Runs Get

key.title: Key
key.description: What node_attributes takes: a column name or a derived field

attr_key.title: Attr Key
attr_key.description: The key it gets in a node's attr

fill_pct.title: Fill Pct
fill_pct.description: % of articles with a value (from the profile)

not_for.title: Not For
not_for.description: Entities whose nodes come from this same field (not added to them)

max_item_df.title: Max Item Df
max_item_df.description: Word matching: ignore items in more than this share

max_word_df.title: Max Word Df
max_word_df.description: String similarity: ignore words in more than this share

min_weight.title: Min Weight
min_weight.description: Keep links with at least this many matched article pairs

node_attributes.title: Node Attributes
node_attributes.description: Fields added to each node for attribute search: a column name or a derived field ('country', 'articles'); each node gets the most common values among its articles. Fields missing from the data are skipped.

DatasetProfileOut.title: DatasetProfileOut
DatasetProfileOut.description: Schema, sample rows and statistics (see pipeline/profile.py); null until ready.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it isn't available in this dataset

links.title: Links
links.description: Link fields this entity can be linked by

max_keyword_df.title: Max Keyword Df
max_keyword_df.description: Ignore keywords in more than this share of articles

threshold_default.title: Threshold Default
threshold_default.description: Default for 'threshold' with this model (string similarity only)

type.title: Type
type.description: Relationship, e.g. collaborates_with, shares_keywords_with. Drives the Relationship filter.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Strength, e.g. number of shared articles.

anyOf.description: Display/search-only attributes. Never drives color or the Group/Relationship filters. Empty values are omitted.

id.title: Id
id.description: ORCID, LOCAL-<hash>, or an institution/country name. Never a raw author name.

team.title: Team
team.description: Drives node color and the Group filter. 'other' = real value outside the top-N; 'unknown' = no value.

anyOf.description: Display/search-only attributes. Never drives color or the Group/Relationship filters. Empty values are omitted.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Every field a node attribute can come from: derived ones, then the dataset's columns (only the defaults while the profile isn't ready)

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: Send back in the X-CSRF-Token header on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE (also set as a readable cookie).
